name: winged_ignores_ground_towers
description: Winged is binary (design 3.2): an Arrow Tower and a Cannon Tower never fire at a Duskmoth hovering over the road beside them, a cannon shell bursting on a Gourdling right under a Duskmoth leaves the moth untouched, and the same arrow forked to the Skyward Loft (air) strikes it.

steps.assert: scene.creep(moth).winged and built[0].shots == 0 and built[1].shots == 0 and built[0].target == 0
steps.msg: four seconds beside a Duskmoth: neither ground tower aims or fires

steps.assert: built[1].shots > 0 and scene.events_where('EFFECT', {'tower': built[1].id}).size() > 0 and scene.creep(gourdling) == null
steps.msg: the cannon shelled the Gourdling under the moth to death
and its bursts left the Duskmoth untouched
branch B made the arrow a Skyward Loft, which reaches the sky
